deduplicate_crystal_structures: deduplicate crystal structures in a pandas DataFrame using hash-based pre-filtering and parallel crystallographic comparison
deduplicate_and_remove_duplicates: deduplicate crystal structures and remove duplicates keeping one representative per group from a DataFrame
process_structure_group_clustering: process a pre-filtered structure group using greedy clustering and StructureMatcher for crystallographic deduplication
deduplicate_with_custom_tolerance: deduplicate crystal structures with custom lattice, site, and angle tolerance parameters for similarity matching
deduplicate_with_parallel_jobs: deduplicate crystal structures in parallel across multiple CPU jobs for large structure databases
